heading: Today
text: Mostly sunny, except clouds through the northern mountains giving way to increasing afternoon sun, last far northeast.  Breezy and chilly.  Highs only in the upper 40s to low 50s north, in the 50s south.  Winds northwest 10 to 15 mph, gusting 25 to 35 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear, with some high clouds late through the St. Lawrence, spreading east near and north of the Quebec border.  Patchy valley fog.  Areas of frost and freezing temperatures.  Lows in the 30s, some 20s in the cold spots.  Winds northwest 10 to 15 mph this evening, becoming light, turning to the south in the Champlain Valley late.

heading: Wednesday
text: Partly sunny north, and sun mixing with clouds south.  A chance of a few showers through Quebec, spotty south to the Adirondacks and Rt. 2.  Highs in the upper 50s to low 60s, mid 60s in the Champlain and southern valleys.  Winds light, becoming south near 10 mph east, 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph from the Green Mountains west.
